sentences.text:
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 Writ Petition No.2784 Of 2023
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.1 to 5, Sri P.Harsha Reddy, learned standing counsel appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.6 and 7 and learned counsel appearing on behalf of unofficial respondent Nos.9 to 13.
2.

The petitioners approached the Court seeking the prayer as follows:
"to issue a Writ order or direction more particularly in the nature of WRIT OF MANDAMUS declaring the action of respondents 1 to 4 particularly 3rd respondent in contemplating to disburse compensation amount payable for the land of Ac.9.18 guntas in survey number 107 of Kommepally Village in Sathupally Mandal of Khammam District pursuant to preliminary notification issued under Section 11 (1)
and issued declaration under Section 19 of Central Act 30 of 2013 issued by respondents 2 and 3 in favour of respondents 8 to 14 as illegal irregular irrational violative of provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and offends articles 14, 21 and 300 A of Constitution of India and consequently direct the WP_2784_2023 SN,J respondents 2 and 3 to pay compensation to the petitioners for their said lands or alternatively refer the dispute to the competent authority under section 64 of said statute for decision by depositing compensation under Section 77 thereof without paying to respondents 8 to 14 and pass such other order or orders as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case."
3. It is represented by learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition that the writ petition could be disposed of directing the respondents to refer the subject dispute to the competent authority under sections 76 and 77 of the Act.

4. Taking into consideration the said submission made by the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition, the subject issue i.e., compensation amount payable for the land under acquisition to an extent of Ac.9.18 guntas in survey No.107 of Kommepalli Revenue Village in Sathupalli Mandal of Udathaneni Satyanarayana And 3 Others vs State Of Telangana And 13 Others on 9 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32358586/
1 Khammam District, pursuant to preliminary notification in Rc.No.G1/2473/2015 dated 23.03.2002 and District Gazette Notification No.A3/15/2022, dated 01.04.2022 issued under Section 11 (1) of Central Act, 30 of 2013 is directed to be referred to the competent authority under sections 76 and 77 of the Act by the 3rd respondent within a period of two (02) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
WP_2784_2023 SN,J 5.
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition, shall stand closed.

_ MRS JUSTICE SUREPALLI NANDA Date:
09.06.2023 Kgk Udathaneni Satyanarayana And 3 Others vs State Of Telangana And 13 Others on 9 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32358586/
